title: auth.wallet-lock.v1
description: Wallet lock command for mw-auth (spec 18.7 Revocation, ticket 70), owned by its consumer mw-auth. Produced by mw-admin-api after maker-checker approval (ops UNLOCK of ticket 52), later by mw-compliance and mw-care-api. LOCK puts an ADMIN lock on the wallet and ends every session and refresh family (login and assertions are refused with MW-AUTH-043 until UNLOCK); UNLOCK removes the ADMIN lock and the PIN lockout (every level, the wrong-PIN count to 0); REVOKE_SESSIONS ends every session and refresh family and locks nothing. Applied once per commandId (inbox); a wallet mw-auth does not know is skipped. Key: walletId. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

commandId.description: Unique per command; the consumer's dedup key.

walletId.description: The core's wallet id (the MSISDN for app wallets).

reason.description: Why, free text (an operator's reason, a compliance case); kept with the lock and in the audit trail.

id.description: Operator username (the checker) or the producing service.

changeRequestId.description: The approved mw-admin-api change request, when there is one.
